result: High school politics may be known for fierce competition, but the real fight for power takes place behind the microphone. Reporting Live pulls back the curtain on a world where news coverage has reached an unprecedented level of ruthlessness and deceit. While student politicians are undeniably driven to win, they are completely outmatched by the young journalists who report on them.

In this cutthroat environment, the race to secure the front page quickly turns vicious. Driven by an overwhelming obsession to capture the biggest headlines, these ambitious young reporters are willing to cross any boundary imaginable. In a game where securing the lead exclusive is all that matters, these youths will stop at nothing—and would quite literally kill—to land the top story.
